programme_facts.value: Explore scholarships at University of Limerick and discover a wide range of financial supports for undergraduate, postgraduate and international students.

UL scholarships recognise academic excellence, sporting achievement, leadership potential and contributions to community engagement, helping students achieve their educational goals while reducing the cost of study.
This page provides up-to-date information on available scholarships, eligibility criteria, application deadlines and funding opportunities at one of Ireland’s leading universities.
The European Union will award scholarships to around 30 outstanding students in the first TELME cohort. These scholarships cover tuition fees, travel expenses, and living costs.
